html:
Fixed

  • Diagram at the very bottom of a long page was captured only sometimes. On a page like *Overview - Cylinder Head*, the tightening-specifications-and-sequence picture sits at the bottom, where ELSA doesn’t load it until you scroll down. If you scanned from the top, the scan could miss it — so it showed up on some scans and not others. The scan now nudges those not-yet-loaded pictures to load and waits for them before finishing, so the bottom diagram is grabbed reliably without having to scroll down first. (No re-drag needed.)
